summary.text: Debbie Villio is a Republican member of the Louisiana House of Representatives for District 79, representing Jefferson, according to the House member page.
The page lists 2019 as the year elected.
The page lists Debbie Villio with committee assignments including Administration of Criminal Justice (Chair).

paragraphs.text: The House member page lists Debbie Villio's occupation as Attorney.
It lists Debbie Villio's education as J.D., Loyola, 1988; General Studies, University of New Orleans, 1985.
The House member page lists Debbie Villio's committee assignments as Administration of Criminal Justice (Chair); House Select Committee on Women and Children.
It lists caucus and delegation affiliations as Jefferson Parish Legislative Delegation; Louisiana Legislative Women's Caucus; Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation.
